title: Add "Clone panel" to Manage Panels and Desktops
line: Panel menus in Manage Panels and Desktops now have Clone Panel and Clone to Screen entries.
explanation: Cloning a panel was only possible from the panel's own edit mode toolbar; the Manage Panels and Desktops window could only move or remove panels, so its menus had no clone action. The model behind the window now has clonePanelToScreen(), which reuses ShellCorona::clonePanelTo() and keeps the panel's edge on the target screen when it is free (otherwise the first free edge, like Add Panel). Each panel's menu gets "Clone Panel" (same screen) and "Clone to Screen <name>" for every other connected screen.

commits.message:
shell: let Manage Panels and Desktops clone a panel to a screen

Panels could only be cloned from their own edit mode toolbar, so the
Manage Panels and Desktops window had no way to do it. Add a method that
clones a panel onto a screen, keeping its edge when that one is free.

BUG: 518750

shellcontainmentconfiguration: add Clone Panel actions to panel menus

The panel menus in Manage Panels and Desktops could move or remove a
panel but not clone it like the panel's own edit mode can. Add "Clone
Panel" and "Clone to Screen" entries for every connected screen.

BUG: 518750

review.text: The feature cleanly adds Clone Panel and Clone to Screen actions to Manage Panels and Desktops, reusing ShellCorona::clonePanelTo() with sensible free-edge selection and properly hiding clone actions for desktops and disconnected screens. However, the QML visibility filter compares model.screenName !== delegate.screenName instead of screenId, which hides the Clone to Screen entry whenever a user has two identical monitors that share the same manufacturer/model screenName. Also, both the plasma-workspace backend commit and the plasma-desktop UI commit use BUG: 518750, which would close the report prematurely if plasma-workspace merges first.
changes: In plasma-desktop Delegate.qml, filter the Clone to Screen repeater with model.screenId !== delegate.screenId instead of model.screenName !== delegate.screenName so cloning between two identical monitors works.
Change BUG: 518750 to CCBUG: 518750 in the plasma-workspace prerequisite commit, keeping BUG: 518750 on the plasma-desktop UI commit.
